champion.tips: EKKO TIPS AND TRICKS Use your Q to push the minion wave when the enemy is inside the wave. This allows you to push and poke them at the same time. Split push during the mid and late game if no team fights are occurring. Use your strong duelling potential to fight anyone who tries to stop you. In team fights, look to flank the enemy with your W . Use your W from fog of war and then engage once it's about to activate. If your team is not in a position to follow up- don’t go in!
champion.builds: THE BEST EKKO BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR MID IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Ekko Mid build, you should take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Hail of Blades as your keystone, followed by Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Relentless Hunter in the primary tree, as well as Absolute Focus and Scorch in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Hextech Rocketbelt as your first item, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes and Lich Bane. For your last 3 items, you should build Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff and finish with Zhonya's Hourglass. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 51.7% winrate over 6 982 matches played. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Electrocute as your keystone, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Treasure Hunter in the primary tree, and Absolute Focus with Gathering Storm in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Hextech Rocketbelt as your first item, then Sorcerer's Shoes as a second item and Lich Bane as a third item. You want to finish the build with Rabadon's Deathcap, Zhonya's Hourglass and Void Staff. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 52.6% win rate across 3 773 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Ekko Mid build in the current patch, try Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, Dark Harvest, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Treasure Hunter as your primary rune tree, and Absolute Focus with Gathering Storm as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Hextech Rocketbelt as your first item, then finish Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item, and Lich Bane as third item. The last 3 options are Rabadon's Deathcap, Zhonya's Hourglass and Void Staff. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 52.5% win rate over 299 matches played. Situational Ekko Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Ekko build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Ekko runes page.
